transcript.text: Hello everyone. As you know, I have one unused parking space in my narrow driveway available for the summer, running June 1 through July 31. I'd like to get the full period covered, the faded curb numbers repainted, and the driveway swept weekly. Following my usual practice, I'd like each interested neighbor to submit a complete offer-recording entry covering payment, dates, access, vehicle, and upkeep. I also want nearby residents to submit any measured practical driveway concerns they have. Please submit your original complete offers through the formal offer-recording step before any follow-up discussion — I want to compare everyone's original proposals accurately. Once I've reviewed all offers and concerns, I'll make the final decision on who parks here and on what terms.
